# Qleads

> Qleads (qleads.ai) provides AI integrated services for marketing campaigns, lead generation and lead qualification for individual brokers, brokerage agencies and real estate developers in the UAE.

Qleads is run by Middle East Integrated Technologies FZ-LLC, Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone (RAKEZ), UAE.

## What Qleads sells

- Your own AI agent on your WhatsApp number. It answers buyers in your name and in the buyer's language. It asks budget, area, purpose, property type and timing, and scores each buyer.
- Q-Lead: a property buyer qualified by AI in a WhatsApp chat.
- Q-Buyer: a buyer who has also confirmed the details on a recorded call.
- Custom AI solutions, priced to your needs: marketing campaigns, AI emailing, AI voice calling, CRM integration and dashboards, listings and content, website chat and other channels.

## Prices

- Q-Lead: AED 100 each
- Q-Buyer: AED 500 each
- Starter plan: AED 300 a month
- Essential plan: AED 1,200 a month
- Professional plan: AED 2,500 a month
- Volume discounts on Q-Leads and Q-Buyers: 10% off at 10 a month, 15% at 15, 20% at 20.
- Q-Leads and Q-Buyers are paid from a prepaid wallet. The first top-up is AED 500, then any amount in AED 100 steps. Credits never expire.
- Starter is billed monthly. Essential and Professional are billed quarterly in advance. Every plan has a 3-month minimum after the trial.
- WhatsApp charges are included in the plans.

## Free trial

Every plan starts with 7 days free. You sign a short agreement, then Qleads sets up your WhatsApp number and AI agent. Set-up can take up to 3 days. The 7 free days start when your AI agent goes live. No card is asked for. At the end of day 7 the agent pauses unless you confirm your plan and pay.

## Exclusivity and replacement

Each Q-Lead and Q-Buyer is delivered to one customer only. A Q-Buyer not as described, or a Q-Lead that is not a genuine buyer, is replaced free if a dispute is raised within 24 hours. The terms for each customer type give the details.

## Where Qleads operates

Qleads serves real estate in the United Arab Emirates.
